design.residual_fraction_definition: f=beta_aer(ref)/beta_m(ref) from the broad smooth high-altitude component
design.signal_noise: independent multiplicative Gaussian perturbation, 100 realizations per case
design.purpose: Separate boundary residual aerosol, signal noise and lidar-ratio mismatch rather than allowing one nuisance term to be blamed for another.

interpretation: Signal noise increases profile-shape error but does not remove the systematic integrated-column underestimation produced by an aerosol-free boundary assumption when residual aerosol is present.
The existing Rayleigh-window QA remains permissive in this controlled broad-contamination family even as noise is added.

Lidar-ratio error is an independent source of lower-column bias. It can partially cancel or exacerbate boundary-condition bias, so agreement with a control under one assumed lidar ratio cannot by itself validate the boundary.
Boundary residual, signal noise and lidar-ratio uncertainty must remain distinct dimensions in any future method-v5 uncertainty/validation design.
decision: Do not infer boundary validity from apparent lower-column agreement when lidar ratio is uncertain; compensating nuisance errors are possible.
